    • accept

      public FileUpload accept(String accept)
      Restricts the accepted file types. The value is a comma-separated list of file extensions (e.g. .csv), MIME types (e.g. text/csv), or wildcard MIME types (e.g. image/*). The value is used as accept attribute of the file input and to validate files that are selected or dropped. Files that don't match are rejected and reported to the handlers registered with onFileRejected(FileRejectedHandler).

    • maxSize

      public FileUpload maxSize(long maxSize)
      Restricts the maximum file size in bytes. Files that are larger are rejected and reported to the handlers registered with onFileRejected(FileRejectedHandler). A value <= 0 means no restriction.
